properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's real-site pass: real, community-surveyed OpenStreetMap boundary (way 48569996), the same pattern already used for Pier 70's Crane Cove Park (data/manual/pier70_crane_cove_park.geojson) -- not a hand trace or plan-diagram estimate. HIGH CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon tagged with the Mission Bay Parks system's own missionbayparks.com URL for this facility. Covers only this one mapped lot (roughly the Mission Bay Blvd. lawn/plaza between the Radiance and Nektar/Bayer buildings); the wider Mission Bay Commons interim-use area further west (Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens, the soccer field) is a separate, still-interim installation tracked as its own record below (Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons interim area) pending the Future Parks Project's 2028-2030 construction. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: the 'pending the Future Parks Project's 2028-2030 construction' window is from SF Rec & Park's Mission Bay Future Parks Project page (construction begins late 2028, open to the public early 2030), not from the cited Wikipedia or OCII pages; that page is now in source_doc_urls.

properties.p_number: OCII's own materials title the combined feature 'Mission Bay Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17)' -- six separate open-space parcels whose build dates are not given in OCII's materials (the OCII pages cited here list P16 and P17 only as 'Completed'; the one dated source found, a Nov 2011 EPA release, calls P16 'the newest segment' and 'recently completed'; P12/P13/P15 are the interim-use strip, tracked separately below as 'Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons interim west'). This record's real OSM way (48569996) covers one specific mapped lot (the Mission Bay Blvd lawn/plaza) within that six-parcel assemblage; which exact P-number(s) it corresponds to is NOT confirmed by any source found -- left unconfirmed rather than guessed. (https://sfocii.org/projects/mission-bay-south/open-space; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf)
properties.notes: Part of Mission Bay's parks system; open by fall 2010 per Wikipedia's Mission Bay article. OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update cites the 1998 'Design for Development' goals for the Mission Bay Commons as a whole, but no cited source states that this lot was completed as part of the original 1998 plan.
